title: Page 7
slug: 捡夫宝娘子-金妍-戚家四兄弟只剩他戚无双这个当家老大还未娶妻-看弟弟们恩爱成双加上每天被媒婆们当大肥羊紧盯著-他烦不胜烦
content_zh:
就算她真的不爱他，他也认了，他付出的心早已收不回来，只要他爱她，只要她愿意让他爱就好，其他的他都不在乎了。
他不会放弃寻找安儿的，就算她躲到天涯海角，他得花一辈子的时间找她，他也绝对不会罢手。
第8章(2)
在确定宝安儿并没有回宝家之后，戚无双马上派人四处寻找宝安儿的行踪，用尽他所有的人脉，方法，想尽办法都要重新寻回宝安儿。
一天没有她的消息，他就一天心神不宁，日日夜夜在戚家盼望着她能主动回到他的身边，让他有补偿的机会。
在他等待消息的这段日子，他深深地体认到，自己一时被气恼冲昏头，忽略掉许多重要的回忆，真是再愚蠢不过。
不说求亲的事情，当初她愿意为了他，典当掉自己珍惜的发簪，却从没让他知道，如果她真的存心贪图他的回报，肯定会让他知道的，甚至她愿意为了肚子饿的小乞儿，无偿将包子送给他们吃，那真真实实的反应，是他不经意发现的，这些都是事实。
而他却因为自己所听到的片面之词，再加上先入为主的想法，就贸然将她定罪，完全不理会她的解释。
他真愚蠢，越是在乎，反倒越是无法冷静下情绪判断是非对错，所以他才会失去了她，弄得现在后悔不已。
他错了，他真的错了，只要她愿意回到他身边，要他做什么补偿都不要紧，他都心甘情愿……
“大哥，你从刚才到现在连半口糕点都没吃，多多少少吃一点吧。”
花厅里，戚无烟命人泡了壶好茶，并且还吩咐厨子特别制作糕点，说很久没和大哥闲话家常，硬是要陪大哥喝茶谈天，其实是希望能转移大哥的注意力，别让大哥把心思都放在下落不明的大嫂身上，因而折磨了自己。
从派人出去寻找至今已经半个月过去，大哥的失落与沮丧也一天比一天严重，他们这些弟弟们真担心，大嫂的行踪如果永远都找不到，大哥可能会永远无法振作起来。
他不得不怀疑，会不会他们家兄弟都被诅咒了，情路才会如此波折，没一个是平顺的。
“我没什么胃口。”面对桌子上色香味俱全的糕点，戚无双根本看也不看。
“你自己吃吧，不必管我。”
要不是二弟硬要将他从房里拉出来，他也不会坐在这里，他知道二弟是一番好意，希望他能暂时放过自己，别时时刻刻都紧绷着情绪，但他就是无法放松下来。
时序已经入冬，天气也越来越冷，再过不了多久就会开始下起雪，他真的很担心，安儿在外头不知道有没有好好照顾自己，贵叔有没有看好她？
为什么都已经半个多月过去，却还是连点消息都没有？他寝食难安，甚至是食不下咽，一颗心始终忐忑不安，就怕她在外头出了什么意外。
“大哥，就算没有胃口，你还是得强逼自己多多少少吃些东西呀。”戚无烟不得不说，“要不然再这样下去，哪一天好不容易终于有大嫂的消息，你却因为身体太过虚弱而无法亲自去找她，这样你会甘心吗？”

这阵子大哥食欲不振，吃下去的东西少之又少，简直是在折磨自己，他不能任大哥这样下去。
果不其然，戚无烟的这番话“刺激”到戚无双，他终于拿起一块糕点往嘴巴塞，管它味道好不好，他根本无心品尝，只是单纯的填肚子而已。
他不能变得像二弟所说的那样，他要亲自去把安儿给带回来，所以就算他没任何胃口，他还是得吃，把之前没吃的也全都补回来，到时候才会有力气。
“大哥。”就在此时，戚无秋突然兴奋地冲入花厅，语气难掩激动。“有消息了。”
“三弟，你说清楚一点。”戚无双马上站起身，来到戚无秋面前急切地问道：“是有安儿的消息了吗？”
“是的，我们已经掌握到大嫂的行踪了。”
“太好了。”戚无双兴奋地催促。“快，我们立刻出发，我已经不想再等下去了。”
他原本低落的情绪顿时振奋起来，他等了这么久，终于等到安儿的消息，他一定得好好把握这个线索，以最快的速度到她的身边去。
他一定会带她回来的，不管得用什么办法，得耗上多少时间，他绝对不会放弃。
宝安儿当初被戚家的车夫送回宣河县后，并没有回到宝家，而是悄悄地带着贵叔马上离开宣河县，打算找一个没人认识她的地方暂时落脚。
她离开戚家时，除了身上的一套衣裳，以及她娘亲遗留下来的那支发簪，她什么都没带，这才能显示她的决心，她不希罕戚家的任何一样东西。
而她之所以不回宝家，原因很简单，现在的宝宅也是属于戚家的，她既然打算离开戚家，当然也不会再住在和戚家有关的房子里，她要和戚家断得一干二净。
她知道自己这么做有一半的原因是在和无双赌气，但她真的咽不下被误会的那一口气，所以她一定要证明给他看，她宁愿自己一个人在外头生活，也不希罕戚家的锦衣玉食。
她再度当掉发簪筹措盘缠，之后便和贵叔来到一座小县城，这座县城里没有无戚钱庄的分号，正合她的意，她决定在这个地方找间小屋子租下，重新开始，然后像从前一样，靠自己的手艺卖肉包挣钱。
“小姐，你再回去多休息一会儿吧。厨房里有我看着就好。”贵叔看着宝安儿连连打呵欠的模样，心疼地劝着。
在离开戚家之后，小姐始终神色憔悴，睡也睡不好，　加上天还没亮就得起来制作包子，看得出她累坏了。
他无法阻止小姐离开戚家，只能选择跟她一起走，虽然他们从前也吃过苦，但看着小姐抛弃锦衣玉食的日子，又开始辛苦工作起来，他还是忍不住感到心疼呀。
“我没事的，”宝安儿还是坚持顾着炉火。“等过一会儿就会完全清醒过来的。不要紧啦。”
“反正炉火我顾也行，等要出门去早市时我再叫你起来，好吗？”贵叔硬是把宝安儿往厨房外推，不让她再硬撑。
“贵叔……”

“好啦好啦，就这么说定了，你先去休息吧。”
宝安儿无奈地退出厨房，只好接受贵叔的好意，转身打算回房里小憩一会儿，免得到早市时还是连连打呵欠，完全提不起精神。
砰砰砰。
当她经过小小的前厅，厅门传来有人拍打门板的声音，这间小屋子前厅的门一开就是外头的小巷道，没有跨院将前厅和大门隔开，因此有人上门来找，当然就是直接拍到前厅的门了。
这一大早的，会是谁来敲门？她虽然感到困惑，却还是走向前，
她惊，又怨，又酸涩，那五味杂陈的滋味涨满胸口，让她不知道该有什么样的反应，不知道该说什么话，只是和他无声地对望着。
是无双。她知道凭他的财与势，想寻找她的行踪不是一件难事，但她没想到的是，在短短一个月之后，他就追来了。
“安儿，”戚无双终于见到自己朝思暮想的人儿，心情难掩激动，“我终于找到你了，跟我回家好吗？”
当他站在门外，见到她居然住在这么老旧的屋子里，又重新开始卖肉包维生，他是既心痛又自责，气自己没有和她好好的把话说清楚，才会让事情演变成现在这样。
content_en:
Even if she really doesn't love him, he admits it. He can no longer take back what he has given. As long as he loves her, as long as she is willing to let him love her, he doesn't care about anything else.
He will not give up looking for An'er. Even if she hides in the ends of the earth and he has to spend his whole life looking for her, he will never give up.
Chapter 8(2)
After confirming that Bao An'er had not returned to Bao's home, Qi Wushuang immediately sent people to search for Bao An'er's whereabouts, using all his connections, methods, and methods to find Bao An'er again.
A day without news from her would make him restless. He would stay at Qi's house day and night, hoping that she would take the initiative to return to him so that he could have a chance to make amends.
As he waited for the news, he realized that he could not have been more stupid than to be so angry that he ignored many important memories.
Not to mention the marriage proposal, she was willing to pawn her cherished hairpin for him, but she never let him know. If she really wanted his reward, she would definitely let him know. She was even willing to give buns to hungry beggars for free. That real reaction was something he discovered by accident. These are all facts.
But because of the one-sided words he heard and his preconceived ideas, he rashly convicted her and completely ignored her explanation.
He was so stupid. The more he cared, the less he could calm down his emotions and judge right from wrong. That's why he lost her and now regrets it.
He was wrong, he was really wrong. As long as she was willing to come back to him, it didn't matter what compensation she asked him to make, he was willing to do it...
"Brother, you haven't even eaten half a mouthful of pastries from just now to now. Eat more or less."
In the flower hall, Qi Wuyan ordered someone to make a pot of good tea, and also ordered the cook to make special cakes. He said that he had not chatted with his eldest brother for a long time, so he insisted on drinking tea and chatting with his eldest brother. In fact, he hoped to divert his attention and prevent him from focusing on his missing sister-in-law, thus torturing himself.
Half a month has passed since people were sent out to search, and the eldest brother's loss and depression are getting worse day by day. The younger brothers are really worried that if the whereabouts of his sister-in-law are never found, the eldest brother may never be able to cheer up.
He had to wonder if all their brothers had been cursed, which was why their love journey was so twists and turns, none of them were smooth.
"I have no appetite." Qi Wushuang didn't even look at the delicious pastries on the table.
"You can eat it yourself and don't worry about me."
If the second brother hadn't forced him to pull him out of the room, he wouldn't be sitting here. He knew that the second brother had good intentions and hoped that he could let him go temporarily and stop being tense all the time, but he just couldn't relax.
Winter has already entered, and the weather is getting colder and colder. It won't be long before it starts to snow. He is really worried. I wonder if An'er is taking good care of herself outside. Is Uncle Gui taking good care of her?
Why is it that more than half a month has passed and there is still no news? He couldn't sleep or eat well, and he couldn't even eat. His heart was always uneasy, fearing that something might happen to her outside.
"Brother, even if you have no appetite, you still have to force yourself to eat more or less." Qi Wuyan had to say, "Otherwise if this continues, one day we finally get news about my sister-in-law, but you are too weak to go find her in person. Will you be willing to do this?"
The eldest brother has lost his appetite these days and eats very little. He is simply torturing himself. He cannot let his eldest brother go on like this.
As expected, Qi Wuyan's words "stimulated" Qi Wushuang. He finally picked up a piece of pastry and stuffed it into his mouth. Regardless of whether it tasted good or not, he had no intention of tasting it. He was just filling his stomach.
he can't become likeAs the second brother said, he wanted to bring An'er back in person, so even if he had no appetite, he still had to eat and make up for what he had not eaten before, so that he would have strength.
"Brother." At this moment, Qi Wuqiu suddenly rushed into the flower hall excitedly, his tone unable to conceal his excitement. "There's news."
"Third brother, please make it clear." Qi Wushuang stood up immediately, came to Qi Wuqiu and asked eagerly: "Is there any news about An'er?"
"Yes, we have learned the whereabouts of my sister-in-law."
"Great." Qi Wushuang urged excitedly. "Quick, let's leave immediately, I don't want to wait any longer."
His originally depressed mood suddenly cheered up. He had been waiting for so long and finally received news about An'er. He must grasp this clue and get to her as quickly as possible.
He will definitely bring her back. No matter what method he has to use or how much time it takes, he will never give up.
After Bao An'er was sent back to Xuanhe County by the Qi family's coachman, she did not return to the Bao family. Instead, she quietly took Uncle Gui and left Xuanhe County immediately, intending to find a place where no one knew her to stay temporarily.
When she left the Qi family, she took nothing with her except a set of clothes and the hairpin left by her mother. This could show her determination. She didn't care about anything from the Qi family.
The reason why she did not return to the Bao family was very simple. The current Bao house also belonged to the Qi family. Since she planned to leave the Qi family, of course she would not live in a house related to the Qi family again. She wanted to completely break up with the Qi family.
She knew that half of the reason why she did this was to be angry with Wushuang, but she really couldn't hold back the breath of being misunderstood, so she had to prove to him that she would rather live outside by herself than care about the rich clothes and food of the Qi family.
She once again pawned her hairpins to raise money, and then she and her uncle came to a small county town. There was no branch of Wuqi Bank in this county town, which was exactly what she wanted. She decided to find a small room to rent in this place, start over, and make money by selling meat buns with her own skills as before.
"Miss, please go back and rest for a while. It'll be good as long as I'm watching over you in the kitchen." Uncle Gui advised him with distress as he saw Bao An'er yawning repeatedly.
After leaving Qi's house, the young lady always looked haggard and couldn't sleep well. Plus, she had to get up before dawn to make steamed buns, so it was obvious that she was exhausted.
He couldn't stop the young lady from leaving the Qi family, so he could only choose to go with her. Although they had suffered hardships in the past, he still couldn't help but feel distressed when he saw the young lady abandoning the good life and starting to work hard again.
"I'm fine," Bao An'er insisted on looking at the fire. "You'll wake up completely in a while. It doesn't matter."
"Anyway, I can take care of the fire. I'll wake you up when you're about to go to the morning market, okay?" Uncle Gui pushed Bao An'er out of the kitchen to prevent her from holding on any longer.
"Uncle Gui..."
"Okay, okay, it's settled, you go and rest first."
Bao An'er reluctantly left the kitchen, had no choice but to accept Uncle Gui's kindness, and turned around to go back to the room to take a nap, lest she still yawned again and again during the morning market and completely lost her energy.
Bang bang bang.
When she passed the small front hall, there was a sound of someone tapping the door panel. The door of the front hall of this small house opened into the small alley outside. There was no cross-yard to separate the front hall from the main door, so someone came to look for her. Of course, they took pictures directly of the front hall door.
Who could knock on the door this early in the morning? Although she was confused, she walked forward anyway.
She was shocked, resentful, and sour, and the mixed taste filled her chest. She didn't know what kind of reaction she should have, she didn't know what to say, so she just looked at him silently.
It is unparalleled. She knew that with his wealth and influence, he wanted to find herHis whereabouts were not difficult to find, but what she didn't expect was that he would come after her in just one month.
"An'er," Qi Wushuang couldn't hide his excitement when he finally saw the person he had longed for, "I finally found you, will you come home with me?"
When he stood outside the door and saw that she actually lived in such an old house and started selling meat buns to make a living again, he felt heartbroken and blamed himself. He was angry that he had not spoken clearly to her, which was why things turned out like this.
